blocks.text: The Philippines made a strong showing at the Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 Preliminary Competition held on October 6, 2026 at Jpark Island Resort & Waterpark in Mactan, Cebu, with representative Gabrielle “Jiji” Galapia earning three awards ahead of the October 10 coronation. Galapia won Miss BE Hotels and Resorts, Best in Swimsuit, and Best in Evening Gown, putting the Philippines in the spotlight as delegates from across the world continue their journey toward the crown. The preliminary competition brought together candidates from different countries for a night that highlighted beauty, confidence and cultural exchange, while also giving Cebu a role […]...
